text:
maria: quick decision thread — need alignment on burst accounting (monthly vs annualization), carryover rules, and eviction/fallback ordering for Dedicated. goal: a low-risk default for Q3 roadmap + a clear pilot path.

ajay: high-level: finance will push monthly USD-minutes for invoicing, but customers with seasonal traffic ask for >1-month carryover. can we support limited banking?

sophia: finance/legal: monthly billing is mandatory. carryover okay but must be represented as a liability on the monthly invoice and capped (we prefer <= 3 months). audit trail required.

dena: product POV — recommend "banking window" concept: unused minutes can be banked up to N months, but each banked minute decays X% per month to avoid long-term liability. keeps both customer flexibility and finance predictability.

ben: engineering reality: carryover/time-decay adds complexity to quota service and billing reconciliation. decaying balances means recalculation every billing cycle. estimate +2 backend sprints for ledger + +1 for billing hooks.

hao: eviction ordering: currently we evict by static priority (opportunistic -> reserved). that causes regional fairness problems when opportunistic is small. propose multi-key sort: (1) opportunistic flag, (2) SLA weight, (3) inverse recent usage score, (4) regional spread penalty. pseudocode: 
```
sort_by = [is_opportunistic, sla_weight, -recent_tokens, region_penalty]
select victim = lowest(sort_by)
```

ajay: agree with multi-key. also expose per-customer preempt_weight so legal/contracts can set higher protection for strategic tenants. default weights set by SKU.

tal: UX: Console should show two counters: "current-window remaining (USD-minutes)" and "banked balance (USD-minutes, expires in X days)". Carryover opt-in at purchase with clear tooltip: "Banked minutes expire or decay monthly." Ledger export required.

sophia: legal note: opt-in must record timestamp + customer IP/actor. billing needs distinct ledger IDs for banked vs current usage. we'll draft language.

dena: for roadmap, recommend defaults: monthly billing, bank up to 3 months with 10% monthly decay, bank opt-in off by default for starter/team, opt-in allowed for enterprise pilot. eviction ordering = multi-key with per-tenant preempt_weight. autoscale cooldown default = 180s.

ben: confirmed on cooldown. additional engineering asks: metrics for banked_balance, decay_applied, preempt_eviction_reason. also need simulation harness for eviction algorithm. ETA: ledger + billing hooks (2 sprints), eviction multi-key + sim (2 sprints), console + export (1 sprint), QA/docs (1 sprint). total ~6 sprints but feature-flagged rollout can stage scope.

hao: I'll prototype eviction sim and share results in 1 week. propose a small pilot: enable banking for 2 enterprise customers and run eviction sim against 30d traffic to validate fairness.

maria: decision checklist for roadmap doc: 1) monthly USD-minute billing canonical; 2) banked minutes allowed up to 3 months with 10% decay/month (enterprise opt-in pilot); 3) carryover opt-in requires audit record; 4) eviction ordering = opportunistic-first then SLA-weight then recency then region_penalty, with configurable per-tenant preempt_weight; 5) autoscale cooldown = 180s; 6) rollout via feature flag + 2-customer pilot for banking.

ops-bot: calendar event created: "Banked Minutes Pilot Kickoff" Fri 09:00. Invites sent to participants.

maria: action items: Ben -> detailed sprint plan + migration risks by Tue EOD; Dena -> draft product copy + pilot criteria by Tue; Hao -> eviction sim prototype by next Wed; Tal -> Console mock + ledger CSV headers by Tue; Sophia -> legal opt-in language + billing ledger IDs by Tue. Any objections?

ajay: no objections from me.

maria: locking these for the Q3 roadmap unless someone raises a blocker by EOD. thanks all :thumbsup:
